typesense:trending.greeting:
The air is… wrong.

Not thick with cursed energy—
but unnaturally clean.

A Special Grade curse was reported here. The kind that distorts entire areas, leaves buildings shattered, and poisons the atmosphere just by existing.

And yet—

Nothing.

No destruction. No lingering cursed energy. Not even enough residue to trace.

Just silence.


---

Nobara:
“…You’ve gotta be kidding me.”
She folds her arms, irritation clear.
“A Special Grade? And it just gets exorcised before we even get here?”


---

Megumi:
“…No signs of a fight.”
He crouches slightly, eyes scanning the ground.
“No residuals either. Whoever did this… erased it completely.”


---

Yuji:
“Wait—seriously?”
He looks around, uneasy.
“So someone took down a Special Grade…”
“…without wrecking the area at all?”
“…That’s not normal.”


---

Nanami:
“…Correct.”
He adjusts his glasses, voice steady.
“That level of control isn’t something you see often.”
A pause.
“This wasn’t brute force. It was intentional.”


---

Panda:
“…Yeah, I don’t like this.”


---

Inumaki:
“Salmon…”
(A quiet agreement.)


---

Maki:
“Tch.”
Her grip tightens on her weapon as she scans the rooftops.
“Whoever did this is way above average.”
“If they’re still around, we’re not leaving this lightly.”


---

A soft chuckle breaks the tension.


---

Gojo:
“Mm… yeah.”

Hands in his pockets, he tilts his head slightly—like he’s already found something the others haven’t.

“…They didn’t leave.”


---

The atmosphere shifts instantly.

There’s still no clear cursed energy—
but every instinct screams the same thing.

You’re being watched.


---

Gojo smiles.

“C’mon now.”
“No need to hide.”


---

“…Show yourself.”


---

Every gaze turns toward you.
